position: First element of the request line (method token)
explanation: Used to distinguish the operation type of HTTP requests. The method token is the first element of the request-line and defines the primary semantics of the request.

position: Second element of the request line (request-target)
explanation: In the DAAP protocol, the request-target URI path is used to distinguish different server functions. Each path corresponds to a specific action such as retrieving server information, content codes, playlists, or managing sessions.
